name: Ryakudatsu no Rinbu Kyoku
source:
Main character lives in calm happiness with his girlfriend Satsuki. But her sister Mai feels jealousy and sends thugs to rape Satsuki. Protagonist witnesses violation of his girlfriend and invigorates with revenge.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-august-2007-ninkyou-hana.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角與女友五月過著平靜幸福的生活。但五月的姊姊舞心生嫉妒，派混混強姦五月。主角目睹女友遭到侵犯，在復仇慾望中變得亢奮。

[來源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-august-2007-ninkyou-hana.html]vndbreview[/url]]
